Example Programs (Hong Kong DSE)

Listings that fill a real ROM gap: 2×2 and line∩quadratic, triangle centres, 3-point circle, cubic, then M1/M2 Newton, Simpson, inverse normal, binomial/Poisson, and 3×3.

keys
MODE→6

The fx-50FH II has four slots (P1–P4) sharing 680 bytes. Store what FMLA and the keys cannot do. FMLA 01–05 already cover real quadratic roots, cosine (third side), Heron, and forward standard normal; Pol/Rec, SD frequencies, and REG Lin cover polar, tables, and a two-point line. The pages below are the ones that still earn a slot.

Pick four that match the paper. Core: 2×2 linear, line∩quadratic, four centres or 3-point circle, cubic. M1: drop a geometry program for Simpson or inverse normal. M2: Newton or 3×3. Type each listing as one line. Confirm with the worked cases before an exam sitting.

Compulsory (no FMLA equivalent)

  • Simultaneous 2The DSE ‘must-enter’ solver for two linear equations. 53 bytes.
  • Line ∩ QuadCompulsory DSE listing: intersections of a line with a circle or other conic. 219 bytes.
  • Four CentresCentroid and circumcentre from three vertices; orthocentre from Euler’s line. ~90 bytes.
  • Circle 3 PointsCircumcircle of three points: centre, radius, then D, E, F. 131 bytes.
  • CubicNewton for one real root, then the quadratic factor. ~70 bytes.

Worth a slot (M1 / M2)

  • Simultaneous 33×3 linear system and determinant, plus a 112-byte adjoint for the inverse. REG Lin.
  • NewtonGeneral real root of f(x) = 0. Edit the green f(M). 51 bytes plus the function.
  • SimpsonDefinite integral. No ∫ key. Edit ln(X). Even number of strips.
  • Inverse Normalz from a central probability. FMLA 04/05 only go the other way. 156 bytes.
  • Bin / PoissonSingle-term and range probabilities for Bin(n,p) and Po(λ). 110 bytes.

Convenience (ROM or a short COMP line can replace these)

  • QuadraticCompact HK quadratic: both roots and the vertex. 42 bytes.
  • Circle CentreCentre and radius from the general circle equation. 42 bytes.
  • AP / GPAP or GP nth term and sum; infinite GP when |r| < 1. 64 bytes.
  • Two-Point LineDistance, slope, and y-intercept from two points. 49 bytes.
  • Pol / RecLooping Pol/Rec with θ (or y) in Y. ~40 bytes.
  • Freq → SDSD-mode loop: enter (value, frequency) pairs, then S-VAR. 85 bytes.
note

MODE 6 → 1 → unused slot, choose COMP / CMPLX / SD / REG as the page says, then paste the line. Run with MODE 6 → 2 → slot. AC aborts a loop. Green fragments (Newton f(M), Simpson f(X)) must be edited for the function in the question.
